name: Disarming Rend (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Rend, Str 13

Benefit(s): In addition to your normal rend damage, you may attempt to disarm your victim without provoking an attack of opportunity. When doing so you gain a +2 bonus to the Combat Maneuver check.
